value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Lemoore/Kings County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value: All building permits, plan submissions, and business licenses are handled through the online Building Permit and Inspection Portal
Inspection requests must be received by 4:30pm to be scheduled for the following business day; Building Inspection services run Monday-Friday 9am-4:30pm

Permits issued through the online portal must be scheduled either through the portal or by email at permits@lemoore.com (the phone inspection request line is only for permits not issued through the portal)
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Division inspection/portal process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.
